title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery — Reduced-Withholding Requests
content:
## Situation of use and capability

A reduced-withholding request on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** records the monthly withholding proposed for the debtor's benefit payments.

The recording tool records, on a verified caller's behalf, the debtor's request to have the monthly withholding from their VA benefit payments for one debt reduced to a smaller monthly amount. One call records one pending reduced-withholding request on that debt, received today by phone, stating the monthly withholding proposed. The request carries no Financial Status Report of its own. The debt's balance, status and current withholding are not changed.

## How it is invoked

The tool is `record_reduced_withholding_request_043db99b`. The representative unlocks it and calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `debt_id` | The reference number of the VA debt whose withholding is to be reduced, as shown on the debt record returned by the debt lookup for this debtor | Identifier text |
| `requested_amount` | The monthly withholding proposed, in USD | A positive number with 2 decimal places, stored rounded half-to-even to the cent; passed at cent precision |
| `received_within_hold_window` | Whether today falls inside the debt's collection-hold window counted from its notice date | `true` when today is within that window; `false` when today is after that window has closed |

## Return

A successful call returns `request_id` (reference number of the request; its presence means the request is on file), `debt_id`, `request_kind` (always "reduced_withholding"), `received_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `requested_amount` (USD with 2 decimal places) and `decision_outcome` (always "pending").

## Basis Q&A

**Does recording the request change what is withheld this month?** No. The current withholding, the balance and the status are unchanged by the request itself.

**Does the request carry a Financial Status Report?** No; it carries none of its own.
